column1: # WP-27 label table v1: each dictionary label maps to one role.
# Columns: language, label (exact provider text), role, value.
# Roles: pos (value = class or class::subclass), register, region, field,
# script, origin, note (value empty = no tag), name (proper-noun senses, no tag).
# Only pos rows make lab::pos::* tags. A Japanese label with no row is
# reported and never tagged; an English label with no row is a Cambridge
# guide word (the sense's short meaning) and is ignored.
# Classes: noun verb adjective adverb pronoun function number expression affix interjection
